verification.method: scripts/verify/sudan.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area; 8th in Africa and 2nd in Northern Africa after Egypt; about 8.6 times 1950
2023: net outflow (largest in the series, second worldwide after Pakistan), natural increase and the near-zero net change; 2022 growth; net inflows 2025 and 2026
Rises in every year 1950–2100; passes 100 million in 2062; 2050, 2075 and 2100 totals and 14th rank in 2100
Fertility 1971 high, 2100 rate, never below 2.1; births 2026; median age; life expectancy
Urban share 1950, now and 2050; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 72 of 72 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
